name: Click Buffer
description: Input buffer: click up to N ticks early and the mod fires the click on the first tick it would actually work.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Ticks
buffer-ticks.description: How many physics ticks early a click can be. 1 tick is about 4.17 ms at the default 240 TPS, so 5 ticks is about 21 ms and 30 ticks is about 125 ms. 0 turns buffering off.

buffer-ground.name: Buffer Ground Jumps
buffer-ground.description: Buffer clicks for cube, ball, robot and spider that are made just before landing.

buffer-orbs.name: Buffer Orbs / Rings
buffer-orbs.description: Buffer clicks that are made just before touching an orb or ring.

practice-only.name: Only In Practice / Test Mode
practice-only.description: Turn the buffer off in normal runs, so it can only help you while practicing.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Write a line to the Geode log whenever a click is buffered, fired or expires. Useful for checking the tick window.
